name: core-arrive
title: Core: arrivals
description: The JavaScript half of the tala stagger for lists that arrive (menu, event-list, gallery, data-table rows). The stagger itself is CSS in each component; this marks an item seen once its arrival has played so a sort or a re-append never replays it, starts a later batch again from the first beat, switches arrivals off in quiet and under reduced motion, and where sibling-index() is missing hands each item its delay from talaDelay(). Items that would wait past the 600 ms cap arrive with the first beat.

budget.reason: One small helper shared by four lists instead of four copies.

motif.gloss: No cultural motif; shared infrastructure, nothing drawn from a tradition.
